identity: Published PINDER evaluation harness; FroDock listed as docking baseline candidate with unresolved external setup.

build_commands.context: Published source-install command, executed from pinned repository root; not run during intake.

run_commands.context: eval_dir is the directory of ranked predictions following published layout. CLI scores predictions; does not generate docking poses.

published_configuration.evaluator: MethodMetrics, native PINDER structures, rank parsed from prediction filename, CAPRI metrics; full defaults in pinned implementation.
published_configuration.unavailable_reason: PINDER has FroDock wrapper and Docker recipe but no verified obtainable external software archive, immutable FroDock pin or complete published parameter file.

docking_baseline_candidate.name: FroDock
docking_baseline_candidate.pin_reason: No immutable external software identifier verified.
docking_baseline_candidate.licence_reason: Linked software download unreachable; PINDER Apache licence does not establish external software permission.
docking_baseline_candidate.published_run_template: pinder_methods predict -m <method> -s <test set> -l <list of PINDER ids> -c `config` -r `results_dir`
docking_baseline_candidate.additional_evidence: Pinned runner contains pd.from_csv and wrapper path/copy handling that require reproduction; no working optimized implementation is claimed.
